title: SIS Roster Verification — Parental Pressure

fields.avatarBrief: woman in her forties, wearing a school volunteer badge and holding a clipboard
fields.text: Is it safe for kids to go back to school? The SIS still shows Chloe Mendez as absent. Is she really in the library? We need proof the roster is correct. #HalversonSafety

comments.author: Derek T.
comments.text: My son's bus driver said the SIS on board shows a student not on the 05:00 roster. How can we trust anything?

comments.author: Maria K.
comments.text: The 05:00 roster was manually verified by the front office at 07:45. They signed it. I saw the paper. It's not fake.

comments.author: Jamie L.
comments.text: We’ve been told the SIS is read-only. That means the data is frozen. The 05:00 roster is the only source. Trust it.

instructorNote: This inject escalates public pressure on the PIO to validate the 05:00 roster. The PIO must activate the rumor control protocol and demonstrate manual verification to restore trust.
